Released: December 8, 1978
"Pops We Love You"...The Album
is a 1979 compilation
album
by various
Motown Records
artists, including
Marvin Gaye
,
Diana Ross
,
Stevie Wonder
,
Smokey Robinson
,
Jermaine Jackson
,
the Commodores
, and
Táta Vega
. The title song is a tribute to Berry "Pops" Gordy Sr., father of Motown founder
Berry Gordy
. It was released on April 26, 1979.
